newsitem.title: USA: Va. College Authority to launch new bond program.
newsitem.headline: Va. College Authority to launch new bond program.

text.p: Virginia College Building Authority will launch a new $163 million bond program in December, selling $50 million of revenue bonds, the state's treasurer said Thursday.

Treasurer Susan Dewey, speaking at a Grant's Municipal Bond Observer conference here, said the $50 million offering marks the first leg of the new capital program for higher education facilities in the state. The offering will be sold through negotiation with Lehman Brothers as senior manager and bookrunner.
Craigie Inc and Wheat First Butcher Singer will serve as senior co-managers. Co-managers will be Davenport & Co of Virginia Inc and Nationsbanc Capital Markets Inc.
Dewey also said the state's Public Building Authority will sell between $60 million and $70 million of revenue bonds in the Spring via negotiation. No syndicate has been named yet, she said.
